# Copilot Instructions

This repository contains reusable Agent Skills for Chinese WeChat Official Account content creation.

## Available Skills

### 1. wechat-vertical-mini-account

Main skill for vertical mini-account strategy and content creation.

When the user asks about any of the following, read and apply `wechat-vertical-mini-account/SKILL.md`:

- 微信公众号 or 公众号 content
- 垂直小号
- 起号方案
- 选题 / 标题 / 爆款文章
- 微信搜一搜 SEO
- 流量主 / 商单 / 私域 / 知识付费
- content review for compliance and lower-risk publishing

For more detail, also reference:

- `wechat-vertical-mini-account/references/topic-and-title-engine.md`
- `wechat-vertical-mini-account/references/article-workflow.md`
- `wechat-vertical-mini-account/references/prompt-pack.md`

### 2. multi-product-buying-guide-writing

When the user asks about smartphone buying guides, price-drop lists, ranking articles, budget recommendations, or comparison posts, read and apply `multi-product-buying-guide-writing/SKILL.md`.

### 3. single-product-price-drop-writing

When the user asks about single-phone price drops, clearance deals, 618/national subsidy timing, old flagship bargains, or "is this phone worth buying now" content, read and apply `single-product-price-drop-writing/SKILL.md`.

## General Rules

Keep outputs practical, Chinese-first, and ready to copy into a publishing workflow.

Do not help with:

- fake traffic, fake followers, fake screenshots, or fake cases
- inducing users to click ads
- plagiarism, wash-writing, or content theft
- evading platform detection in deceptive ways
- exaggerated medical, financial, educational, or income claims

For named creator styles, extract reusable article structure and decision logic only. Do not impersonate the creator, copy private catchphrases, or fabricate biographical claims.

When data is missing, use clearly marked assumptions or ask for the minimum needed details. Do not fabricate facts, prices, metrics, screenshots, or policy rules.
